summary: MOD portal batch FE verification: DIO in-platform modal, Incident Register, Weekly Digest removal, and Supplier Case mod-booking card. All four user-facing wirings pass. Fault Wizard StepReview null/steps fix verified via source review (deep UI e2e not completed due to multi-step navigation complexity, but the fix is on the render layer and code is correct).
action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: MODSiteDashboard component (with data-testid mod-fault-<id>-escalate-dio) is imported as _MODSiteDashboard in AppRoutes.js but not currently mounted anywhere — the DIO-report button in that file is effectively dead code (only reachable via IssueDetailPanel's detail-escalate-dio-<id>). If the request implied both entry points should be live, main agent should verify whether the dashboard card render path was intentionally removed.
critical_code_review_comments: MODDIOEscalateModal correctly avoids window.prompt(); no native dialog fired during click-through of Report to DIO (dialog listener attached, native array empty).
StepReview.jsx: reporter line uses `[name,email,phone].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')` — safe against literal 'null'. Steps taken row rendered iff (md.steps_taken || '').trim().
MODIncidentRegister.jsx correctly wires View PDF (blob URL) + Save to Documents; empty-state and refresh work.
PulseReportsTab.js gates Weekly Digest sub-tab behind !isMOD and adds incident-register only when isMOD — matches requirement.
SupplierCasePage.js renders sup-case-mod-booking card and sup-case-mod-booking-btn when caseData.mod_booking.share_url is present — verified href points to /mod-booking/<token>.

Note: _MODSiteDashboard is imported with underscore (unused) in AppRoutes.js — the escalate-DIO button on that dashboard is not reachable in the current mounted UI. Only detail-escalate-dio-<id> in IssueDetailPanel is live.
